verdict.reason: Lagide looks like the best bodyboard option for lunch — 13:00.  This should feel like a fun progression session rather than a heavy one.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide should help the reef hold shape.

conversationalSummary.text: Lagide at Lunch — 13:00 looks like the best call. The conditions line up well enough for a worthwhile session without looking too heavy. I'd still give the cam a quick look before leaving, but this is the main plan.

best.explanation: Lagide looks like a fun-sized window for Fun progression, High confidence: 0.9-1.2 m, 164 kJ, 10 s period, consistent 70/100, and wind is not fully clear.  A dependable left-hand reef that turns modest swell into real rides; this is best for clean, playful walls when the bigger beaches are too wild or too small; 10-13s at mid tide suits the reef shelves and gives long workable walls.  Expect: it can get busy, and it is usually more flow than heavy barrel.

ranked.explanation: Cerro looks like a clean fun-sized window for Worth checking, Medium confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 136 kJ, 10 s period, consistent 69/100, and good wind at 10 km/h.  A sheltered beachbreak with gentle lefts and rights, somewhat similar to Cantinho but less consistent; this is best for manageable bodyboard waves when north-northwest swell reaches the bay with clean southerly wind; 10-13s at mid tide works well on exposed beaches.  Expect: it can feel softer or less defined than the main peaks, and rocks may appear closer to the west cliffs.
